mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.25% within a month signals a tightening monetary policy, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as borrowing costs rise and economic activity slows.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in more than 40% of instances where the FEDFUNDS rate increases by more than 0.25% within a month.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% within two months signals a weakening labor market, which historically correlates with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to concerns about consumer spending and economic growth.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in more than 50% of instances where UNRATE rises by more than 0.5% within two months.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real GDP (GDPC1) over two consecutive quarters signals a weakening demand environment, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as corporate earnings expectations are revised downwards.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances where GDPC1 declines for two consecutive quarters.

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% within a month signals a strengthening supply side, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as market sentiment improves.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces negative 5-day returns in more than 40% of instances where INDPRO increases by more than 1% within a month.

mechanism_narrative: A joint increase in housing starts (HOUST) and real final sales of domestic product (RSAFS) by more than 2% each within two months signals a strengthening demand environment, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as consumer confidence and economic activity improve.
candidate_trigger: HOUST and RSAFS both increase > 2% in 2 months
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in more than 40% of instances where both HOUST and RSAFS increase by more than 2% within two months.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.3% within a month signals a strengthening labor market, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as market sentiment improves due to expectations of increased consumer spending.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces negative 5-day returns in more than 40% of instances where UNRATE decreases by more than 0.3% within a month.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) by more than 0.25% within a month signals a loosening monetary policy, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as borrowing costs decrease and economic activity is stimulated.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in more than 40% of instances where FEDFUNDS decreases by more than 0.25% within a month.

mechanism_narrative: A significant decrease in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% within a month signals a weakening supply side, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as market sentiment deteriorates due to concerns about economic growth.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in more than 50% of instances where INDPRO decreases by more than 1% within a month.
